title: Open Editor: two profiles behind one call

fields.title: Two profiles behind one call
fields.subtitle: Code and manuscript, with the same five methods

beats.say: Open Editor is an editor for two kinds of writing: source code, and book manuscripts. This is its first slice.
The quickstart is one page of plain JavaScript. No framework, and no bundler.
One call makes the code editor. The profile says which kind.
beats.text: One call makes the code editor. The profile says which kind.
beats.label: profile: *code*

beats.say: The same call, with another profile, makes the manuscript editor.
beats.label: profile: _manuscript_

beats.say: Here is that page. Code on top, manuscript below.
Type in the code editor, and the page receives the source text after every key.
Type in the manuscript editor. Two stars make a word bold.
What the page receives there is plain text too: a small subset of Markdown.
beats.label: both documents are _plain text_

fields.title: One profile, one engine
fields.body: code 162 kB  ·  manuscript 135 kB  ·  both 296 kB  (gzip)

beats.say: A page that needs one profile loads one engine. These are the measured sizes, compressed.
A test builds, edits and removes each editor fifty times, then asks the browser what is still alive. The guide has what it found.

fields.title: A first slice, not a product
fields.subtitle: No chapters, no export, no collaboration yet

beats.say: It is early. There are no chapters, no export and no collaboration yet. The plan and the next pieces are public.
